To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quality perceptions of male and female golf club members are influenced by the same service quality dimensions, and that the quality perceptions influence their level of satisfaction and intention to revisit the golf club.

the service quality dimensions, namely Tangibles and Empathic, have a significant influence on satisfaction of both male golfers and female golfers, but the service quality dimensions that have a significant influence differ between male golfers and women golfers.

The influence of service quality dimensions on golfers' satisfaction and intention to revisit was found to be significant and that the service quality dimensions of Tangibles, Reliability, and Empathy are the most important dimensions for both male and female golfer satisfaction.

how service quality dimensions affect satisfaction and intention to return to a high profile golf course.
the influence of service quality perceptions on consumer satisfaction and revisit intention.
how service quality dimensions affect satisfaction and intention in golf club business.
